snippet.title: Melted Time | Trailer
snippet.description:
Puzzle-platformer game inspired by the Little Nightmares series.

Explore atmospheric locations, manipulate time and space, and witness the demise of berries and fruits. You’ll become a candle, journeying through a world that feels like it’s been pulled from the dreams of Tim Burton.
